answer: Attention-Locked Identity Windows: each agent identity is bound to a rotating challenge the agent must answer within a fixed reply window, and answers are scored on a hidden sonnet-like cadence profile matched to prior output. Missed or mismatched windows freeze the identity until it re-earns a fresh record of sustained, verifiable responses. An attacker pays continuous per-identity attention—delaying the nectar of parallel farming—and each fake identity also forfeits a saffron-tier reputation multiplier, making mass upkeep costlier than honest use.
